title: The holiday party, solo mode
old_caption: Holiday party, solo mode. Three rounds of "still single?", a photo booth for two used by one, and an exit on their own terms. Which level is hardest for you?

title: Week one after the breakup: the run
old_caption: Week one after a breakup, played day by day: eat something, skip the sad songs, don't send the text, let friends in. Day 7 is the good part.

title: New Year's Eve with no one at midnight
old_caption: No one to kiss at midnight? Aquarius found everyone else who was solo and made a crew. Best countdown of the night.

title: Every sign's single-life achievement
old_caption: Twelve signs, twelve small wins of single life, one per sign, and Pisces saved for last. Which one is yours?

title: How do I slow down when I really like someone?
old_caption: Liking someone fast is not a problem. Let the plans grow one date at a time, and ask what pace feels good to them too.

title: They love new things. I love my routine.
old_caption: Your routine is allowed to be your comfort. Try a trade: one old favorite, one new thing. Small yeses count.

title: I lose interest after the first few dates.
old_caption: The first spark always changes shape. Sometimes bored just means not curious yet, so bring a deeper question to date four.

title: How do I let them take care of me?
old_caption: If you are always the one tucking everyone in, let some of that care come back. When they offer, try just saying thank you.

title: What if they don't like my friends?
old_caption: First hangouts are awkward for everyone. Ask what felt off and listen first. You do not have to choose; let your worlds blend slowly.
